Info.description:
This project houses the suspension dynamics modelling files for the University of New Brunswick Formula SAE team. It is designed to validate suspension geometry and predict vehicle behavior under race conditions. The core model utilizes MATLAB Simulink and Simscape Multibody to simulate the car's response to various track inputs.
Key Features:
Full Ride Model: A complete multi-domain simulation integrating mechanical and hydraulic physical systems.
Weight Transfer Analysis: Scripts and blocks dedicated to analyzing longitudinal and lateral load transfer during acceleration, braking, and cornering events.
Frequency Modeling: Tools for analyzing the natural frequencies of the suspension system to optimize damping ratios and ride quality.
Parameter Database: A centralized repository of car parameters (mass, inertia, stiffness, geometry) ensuring consistency across all simulations.
